instanceUpdate.confirmHeading: How the update keeps your data safe.
instanceUpdate.confirmBody: Solid Memo updates the documents of {name} one by one, each where it is, in a single write that your Pod makes whole or not at all and, where your Pod checks this, only if nothing else changed it since Solid Memo read it. Every document can be read throughout, whether it is updated yet or not. One that cannot be updated now, because it changed elsewhere meanwhile, say, is left as it is, and you can try again: then only what is still outdated is updated. Every address stays the same, and so does who you shared it with.

migrationNotice.howItWorks: Updating brings each document up to date on its own, where it is, one after another, each in a single write that your Pod makes whole or not at all. Every document can be read throughout, updated or not; one that cannot be updated now is left as it is, and you can try again. Every address stays the same; deck names, card text, directions, your review history and your settings stay as they are, and a deck without a description gets a short one you can change.
migrationNotice.catalogueFormat: a catalogue of each instance's decks, which other apps read as a DCAT catalogue
migrationNotice.preferencesFormat: preferences format {version}, which records the answer scale, developer mode, what to do with invalid data and the theme
migrationNotice.deckFormat: deck format {version}, which describes decks with the DCAT and SKOS standards, gives every deck a description and lets a deck's title, description and keywords be in any language you state
migrationNotice.cardFormat: card format {version}, which adds pictures on cards, lets a library deck retire a card it no longer uses and lets a card's text be in any language you state
migrationNotice.reviewFormat: review-state format {version}, which keeps each study direction's state and the day's undo snapshot
